days.focus: Core dribbling patterns with primary skill emphasis

drills.name: Side-to-Side Pops to Shot
drills.description: Game-Speed: Find a line and perform four to five lateral hops on one foot before finding the ground and rising into a shot. Keep your body under control throughout the hops. This challenges fluidity and warms up your ankle while building shooting rhythm.

drills.name: Hezi-Jumpback Explode
drills.description: Technique: From an even stance hesitation where the ball floats, jump backward to sell a forward lean before suddenly exploding past the defender. Use deception with your body language to freeze the defender's feet.

drills.name: Reverse Lunge Overhead to Shot
drills.description: Game-Speed: Perform a reverse lunge with your hands overhead, then quickly pop both feet to the ground into a smooth shot. Transfer the energy from the lunge directly into shooting elevation. Dynamic warm-up.

drills.name: Slow Dribble to Explosive Reach
drills.description: Pressured: Maintain a relaxed, slow dribble with control while a live defender reaches aggressively. The moment the defender commits to a reach, explode past them with an explosive first step. This drill trains you to read defensive aggression and capitalize on overcommitment.

drills.name: Pull the Chair Recovery
drills.description: Pressured: Lean heavily into a defender to create contact. The defender pulls away, and you recover balance to finish.

drills.name: Off-Balance Visualization
drills.description: Game-Speed: Purposefully put yourself in awkward, off-balance positions (simulating a slip or bump) and work to keep your dribble alive and recover. Stay calm and composed while regaining control.

drills.name: Feet-Behind Footwork
drills.description: Game-Speed: Send only your feet behind you (similar to a track start) to create instant forward momentum off the dribble. Keep your upper body lean and eyes forward. This creates explosive separation without losing control.

drills.name: Bump and Score (Step-back)
drills.description: Technique: Drive into a defender to initiate contact, then use that bump to create space for a step-back jumper.

drills.name: Offhand Floater Development Circuit
drills.description: Game-Speed: A high-volume circuit with 20 makes using only the off-hand, alternating one-foot and two-foot floaters.

drills.name: Wichita Step-First Attack
drills.description: Game-Speed: Within the wing series, focus on stepping first as you push the ball out to maximize distance and space.

drills.name: Corner to Wing Shooting
drills.description: Game-Speed: Alternate between corner and wing three-pointers, aiming for a goal (e.g., 7 for 10). Build mental consistency.

drills.name: In Stride Change of Direction
drills.description: Pressured: While maintaining an 80% sprint, make a subtle move to alter your direction without losing any speed or stride efficiency. The move should feel seamless and blend into your forward momentum. Essential for open-court ball-handling.

drills.name: Low Joint Position Mobility Warm-up
drills.description: Game-Speed: Before dribbling, move through low joint positions in different directions. Target mobility for explosive first steps.

drills.name: 2v1 / 1v2 Shooting
drills.description: Game-Speed: Read multiple defenders to find space for a short jumper. The 1v2 version is particularly difficult. Adapt to multiple closes.

drills.name: Overhead Gathered Pound
drills.description: Technique: Perform a maximum speed pound and show the ball in an overhead gather to bait a shot-blocker.

drills.name: Catch and Shoot (On the Move)
drills.description: Form: Hit shots while navigating the court at game speed, simulating relocation or transition actions.

drills.name: Underhand Floater (Same-Foot/Same-Hand)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Use the same foot/hand timing but perform an underhand floater from further away. Make it harder to time.

drills.name: Differential Angle Floaters
drills.description: Pressured: Practice three types of floaters while driving at a different angle for every repetition. Train adaptability.

drills.name: Exaggerated Low to High
drills.description: Game-Speed: Alternate between two extremely low dribbles and two extremely high dribbles. Build adaptability.

drills.name: Feet-Behind Spin
drills.description: Game-Speed: Send your feet behind you and immediately enter a spin move while maintaining momentum.

drills.name: Small Space Reactive Dribbling
drills.description: Technique: Work in a confined space (like a 3x3 area) and react to an imaginary defender's movements with quick changes of direction. Build comfort in tight quarters.

drills.name: Same Foot Same Hand (Off-Foot)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Perform a creative move and finish with a same-foot, same-hand layup. Intentionally difficult for defenders to time.

drills.name: Anchored Pivot Pickup Shoot
drills.description: Game-Speed: Stay anchored on one foot, performing various pounds and freestyle moves before transitioning into a shot. Train shot transitions.

drills.name: Corner Out of Bounds
drills.description: Pressured: Shoot five shots from deep in the corner out of bounds. This challenges arc and precision in a low-intensity environment.

drills.name: Cross-Step Pop (COD Tween)
drills.description: Technique: Cross a foot over and, as soon as the second foot hits the ground, pop back in the opposite direction.

drills.name: Bump and Counter (5 Variations)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Drive into the defender's hip to initiate contact. Following contact, execute five different scoring counters.

days.focus: Contested shooting and creative finishing at max effort

drills.name: Psychological Momentum (Quick Form)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Fast-paced form shooting with a goal (like 10 makes in a row) to build mental confidence and flow state.

drills.name: Kyrie Two-Foot C.O.D. Series
drills.description: Game-Speed: Execute a series of two-foot jumps and change-of-direction moves to shift the defense violently. Each stop should be controlled and ready for the next move. Advanced footwork pattern.

drills.name: Ball Pickup Shots
drills.description: Pressured: The ball starts on the ground. Reach down, change your level to pick it up, and immediately find your rhythm into a shot. Focus on smooth energy transfer from the ground pickup into shooting.

drills.name: Single Leg RDL Reach to Shot
drills.description: Form: Perform a single-leg RDL with a reach-out, then transfer energy into a shot. Switch spots every rep. Build dynamic shooting.

drills.name: Slam and Protect (Rib Tuck)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Finish at the rim and immediately protect the ball by tucking it near your ribs. Simulate a defender attempting to swat or steal. Train contact finishes and ball security.

drills.name: Pound Between-Behind
drills.description: Game-Speed: Pound the ball, go between the legs (dribbling by the big toe), then immediately behind the back while swaying your body with the ball's movement. Work this as a rhythmic drill. Build smooth, coordinated move sequences.

drills.name: Leaning Pull the Chair Recovery
drills.description: Game-Speed: Lean into the defender to create contact. Recover balance despite the sudden loss of resistance.

drills.name: Screen Rejection Jumpers
drills.description: Form: Reject a ball screen by playing through a chest stop or contact from a defender. Recover into a jump shot while feeling the residual contact. Train shooting cleanly through physical disruption.

drills.name: Lunge Stop Anchor Stop Pull-up
drills.description: Pressured: Enter a short lunge during a drive and use an anchor stop (using one foot to kill momentum) to pop into a jumper.

drills.name: Turn and Decide (Close-out)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Turn late to see a defender closing out and decide in a split second whether to shoot or drive.

drills.name: Lava Pop-Back (COD Tween)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Get both feet down off a cross-step. Treat the floor like lava—the instant the second foot touches, pop back explosively.

drills.name: Knee-Push Transition Shot
drills.description: Pressured: Starting from one knee, push out as low and fast as you can into a transition pull-up jumper. Focus on explosive leg drive and balanced footwork. Train the ability to generate shooting opportunities from unconventional positions.

drills.name: Continuous Jolt Cross (No Pound)
drills.description: Technique: Perform back-to-back low jolt crosses without the pound dribble. Emphasize fingertip strength and floating the ball between crosses. Demand high hand coordination at advanced speeds.

drills.name: Two-Step Disentanglement
drills.description: Game-Speed: Starting with no dribble, a defender has their hand on the ball. You have only two steps to get free and finish.

drills.name: Mid-Range Volume Pull-ups (25 Each Way)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Hit 25 pull-up jumpers in each direction. Emphasize legal footwork during the first step.

drills.name: Trey Young High Floater
drills.description: Pressured: The goal is to loft the ball above the backboard so it drops in through the hoop without touching the rim.

drills.name: Spin Downhill (Creative Options)
drills.description: Technique: A defender forces a spin move. Use creative ball-handling options off that spin.

drills.name: Hezi-Even Stance
drills.description: Game-Speed: Bring both feet into an even stance off the dribble, raising your height to hesitate and let the ball float in your hand before exploding forward. The pause should feel like a real read, not a scripted move.

drills.name: Modified Inside-Hand Mikan
drills.description: Game-Speed: Perform a Mikan-style drill using specifically your inside hand to develop soft touch and high spin on the backboard. Work both sides of the rim with the inside hand. Foundational warm-up for advanced finishing.

drills.name: Pound to Jolt Cross
drills.description: Pressured: Perform a standard pound dribble followed immediately by a jolt cross—a low, quick crossover using primarily the fingertips. Keep the transition smooth. Build rhythm in move sequencing.

drills.name: Blended Crossover/Between Series
drills.description: Game-Speed: A moving drill that alternates between crossovers and between-the-legs moves. Keep a slanted posture.

drills.name: Slam and Tuck Protection
drills.description: Game-Speed: Go up strong at the rim and use a rib tuck to protect the ball through contact. This variation emphasizes absorbing a defender's hand or body on the finish.

drills.name: Double Behind to Inverted Snatch
drills.description: Pressured: Execute two behind-the-back dribbles, then step across your body into an inverted snatch move. Keep your coordination smooth and connected through all three moves. This trains the ability to chain moves fluidly without losing rhythm.

drills.name: Accel/Decel Flow
drills.description: Technique: A coordination-heavy drill using one-two, one-two footwork. Sync the ball with your steps.

drills.name: Lunge Stop Series
drills.description: Game-Speed: Enter a short lunge during a drive. Variations include exploding immediately, early explosion, or slowing for a move.

drills.name: Tense to Relaxed Shooting
drills.description: Pressured: A defender pushes and pulls you to throw you off balance. On a go command, shift from tense to relaxed for the shot.

days.focus: Controlled finishing development and technique focus

drills.name: Kyrie 18-Shot Finishing Series
drills.description: Pressured: A structured finishing workout consisting of six specific shots performed with three different timings (18 shots total).

drills.name: Wichita Double Rip
drills.description: Technique: A triple-threat transition drill where you catch on the wing, rip the ball out, then immediately rip back.

drills.name: Double Pump Rhythm Drill
drills.description: Game-Speed: Perform a super-exaggerated pump fake that removes all natural momentum. Immediately refine your rhythm and execute your secondary move or shot. This forces you to work on generating energy from a completely dead stop.

drills.name: Cross Step Inverted Between
drills.description: Game-Speed: Cross one foot over the other while going between the legs. Keep your back foot glued to the ground to project your body forward. The move should be explosive and directional. Create instant separation.

drills.name: Stationary Crossovers (Wide Base)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Stand in a low, wide stance with hips down, crossing the ball back and forth wider than your knees. The body weight must shift in the direction of the ball with every cross. Build fingertip control and rhythm at game-speed transitions.

drills.name: Split Feet Pound-Between
drills.description: Game-Speed: While moving, perform a pound followed by splitting feet as the ball goes between the legs.

drills.name: Wichita Help-Side Counter Pull-up
drills.description: Pressured: Visualize a help-side defender rotating over. Execute a counter-move to transition into a pull-up jumper.

drills.name: The Curry Drill
drills.description: Technique: Start at the three-point line and use quick, subtle footwork (step-backs, side steps, in-and-outs) to create space before rising into a jumper. The moves should feel seamless.

drills.name: Separate Back Separation Shot
drills.description: Technique: Get your defender on your hip or behind you. Practice separating back to create a sudden shooting window.

drills.name: Wimby Pole Read
drills.description: Technique: Drive by an imaginary defender using a pole or net post as reference. Read whether help is coming and adjust your finish or shot accordingly. Train spatial awareness and help-side reads.

drills.name: Weight Shift Pound
drills.description: Pressured: Perform a hard pound dribble at knee-to-hip level while shifting your body weight from side to side. Keep the ball hitting the same spot while your body moves. Build pressure handling.

drills.name: One-Move Capstone Finish
drills.description: Game-Speed: At the end of your finishing workout, perform one high-intensity move of your choice into any creative finishing option you practiced. Test which moves execute effectively when fatigued and reveal your most reliable finishing arsenal.

drills.name: Mid-Court Toss-and-Meet
drills.description: Game-Speed: Toss the ball across the court, meet it at full speed, find your balance, and shoot immediately. Train game-speed mechanics.

drills.name: Overhead Gather Bait
drills.description: Game-Speed: Perform a high-speed pound into an overhead gather, showing the ball to bait a mistimed jump before finishing.

drills.name: Left-Hand Rip Away
drills.description: Technique: As you gather the ball, a defender gets a hand on it. Rip away and finish with your off-hand.

drills.name: Moving Pound Crossovers
drills.description: Game-Speed: Move sideline-to-sideline while performing crossovers where your hips must turn in the direction of the ball to increase explosiveness out of the move. Keep each rep sharp and controlled. Train lower-body coordination with upper-body ball-handling.

drills.name: Arm-Free Pickup Shoot
drills.description: Game-Speed: Drive at game speed with a defender playing tight on your arm. Work to get your arm free specifically during the pickup phase. Get into a fluid shot without allowing the defender to disrupt your rhythm.

drills.name: Escape Floater
drills.description: Pressured: Starting on a defender's hip, push out to escape and perform a fading floater within two dribbles while being chased.

drills.name: Change of Speed Push-Out
drills.description: Technique: Raise your body level to slow down, then drop low into a push-out dribble followed by a quick snatch back.

drills.name: Hop Freestyle
drills.description: Game-Speed: Hop on one leg while maintaining a freestyle dribble, progressively increasing the size and speed of your hops. Build ankle stability and improve ball control during explosive, off-balance movements.

drills.name: High-Speed Skip Pull-ups
drills.description: Game-Speed: Perform two skips as fast as possible into a high-speed three-point pull-up. Train transition shooting.

drills.name: Different Footwork Every Rep
drills.description: Technique: While shooting, you are strictly forbidden from using the same footwork twice. Alternate between turns, pivots, hops, and various lead-foot entries for every make. Prevent overreliance on one setup.

drills.name: Wichita Outside Hip Sweep
drills.description: Pressured: Practice ripping the ball while keeping it strictly on your outside hip. Jerk to the air, not across your body.

drills.name: Corner to Corner Shooting
drills.description: Technique: Alternate corner shots, but the footwork (turn, pivot, or hop) must be different every time. Prevent setup reliance.

drills.name: Visualization Short Jumpers
drills.description: Game-Speed: Move through freestyle dribbles, visualizing bumps, fades, and defenders before pulling up for a short jumper.

drills.name: Shoulder-to-Shoulder Recovery
drills.description: Game-Speed: Get bumped off your driving line and use your shoulder to cut off the defender or counter.

days.focus: Game-speed skill development across block focus

drills.name: Single Hand Freestyle
drills.description: Game-Speed: Move at 100% speed across the court, dribbling fluidly using only one hand. Improve weak-hand confidence.

drills.name: Find the Seams Warm-up
drills.description: Pressured: Toss the ball with various spins and catch it, finding the seams as fast as possible before shooting. Build rhythm.

drills.name: Touch the Net Reach
drills.description: Technique: Drive and try to make the ball touch the net before pulling it back to your shoulder for a protected finish.

drills.name: Dribble-Step Between the Legs
drills.description: Game-Speed: While moving forward, perform a single dribble step between the legs without breaking stride. Your trailing foot must cross over to project your body forward explosively.

drills.name: Double Pump Shots
drills.description: Pressured: Perform a super-exaggerated pump fake that removes all natural momentum. Then refine your rhythm and immediately fire the shot. Works with or without the dribble.

drills.name: Cross-Step Pop (COD Tween)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Cross a foot over and, as soon as the second foot hits the ground, pop back in the opposite direction.

drills.name: Wide Hook Soft Touch
drills.description: Game-Speed: Work on finishing with wide hook shots using both hands. Develop an extended range of touch near the rim.

drills.name: Bump and Counter (5 Variations)
drills.description: Technique: Drive into the defender's hip to initiate contact. Following contact, execute five different scoring counters.

drills.name: Slow Step Extension
drills.description: Game-Speed: While downhill with a defender on the hip, perform a slow step without stopping. Keep momentum alive.

drills.name: Cold Start Threes
drills.description: Game-Speed: Jump straight into shooting three-pointers without any form of warm-up. Train consistency coming off the bench.

drills.name: Hezi-Jumpback Explode
drills.description: Technique: From an even stance hesitation where the ball floats, jump backward to sell a forward lean before suddenly exploding past the defender. Use deception with your body language to freeze the defender's feet.

drills.name: Two-Foot Floater Series
drills.description: Pressured: A Kyrie-style sequence where you perform a cross-between-behind move into a stopped-short two-foot floater.

drills.name: Small Space Reactive Dribbling
drills.description: Technique: Work in a confined space (like a 3x3 area) and react to an imaginary defender's movements with quick changes of direction. Build comfort in tight quarters.

drills.name: Off-Hand Floater Circuit
drills.description: Game-Speed: A high-volume circuit with 20 makes using only the off-hand, alternating one-foot and two-foot floaters. Challenge yourself to be equally comfortable with both hands from the midrange.

drills.name: Ball Screen Hedge & Relocation
drills.description: Game-Speed: Practice playing off a hard hedge from a defender. Work on getting the ball out of the screen to a short-roller (or simulated position), then immediately relocate for a return pass and shot. Trains point guard decision-making.

drills.name: Over-the-Net Reach
drills.description: Game-Speed: Drive and attempt to make the ball touch the net before pulling it back for a protected finish.

drills.name: Find the Seams Dribble-to-Shot
drills.description: Game-Speed: Toss the ball with various spins, catch it, and find the seams as fast as possible while transitioning into a shot.

drills.name: Arm-Free Pickup (Disentanglement)
drills.description: Game-Speed: As you move downhill, a defender keeps a hand on your arm. Get your arm free during the pickup phase.

drills.name: Peripheral Vision/Quiet Eye Turn
drills.description: Game-Speed: Start facing away from the rim. Turn late—sometimes with a defender's hands in your view—and lock eyes to shoot.

drills.name: Anchored Pivot Pounds
drills.description: Game-Speed: Stay anchored on one foot while performing various pound dribbles at game speed. Work improvised pound sequences before transitioning into a shot pickup. Keep the ball hitting the same spot while your body remains centered and ready.

drills.name: Rip-Away Finish
drills.description: Pressured: As you gather the ball, a defender gets a hand on it. Explosively rip the ball away and finish with your off-hand using strong body control. This simulates contact finishes and improves off-hand finishing.

drills.name: Rotational Pulls
drills.description: Game-Speed: Starting stationary or moving, pocket the ball and rotate your body backward before projecting forward.

drills.name: Wichita Wing Series (Step-Over Rip)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Perform a step-over cut to get open on the wing, catch, and execute a hard rip into a one-dribble pull-up. Train wing shooting.

drills.name: Hezi BTB/Push Cross Pull-up
drills.description: Technique: Use a hesitation (hezi) with either a behind-the-back (BTB) or push-cross move to freeze the defender's feet, then immediately rise into a pull-up jumper. The rhythm change should feel smooth. One of the best scoring combinations.

drills.name: Hezi In-and-Out Explode
drills.description: Pressured: Use a hesitation with an in-and-out dribble while raising your body height to freeze the defender.

drills.name: Low-to-Ground Differential Pickup
drills.description: Technique: Force yourself to pick the ball up from extremely low or awkward positions. Challenge your shooting problem-solving.

days.focus: Competitive finishing circuits at elite intensity

drills.name: Wichita Counter to Finish
drills.description: Game-Speed: Catch on a step-over cut, rip the ball. If the middle drive is taken away, counter into a tight finish.

drills.description: Game-Speed: Hit a cross-between-behind combo into a hesitation and use a two-foot jump to shift momentum toward the baseline.

drills.description: Game-Speed: At the end of your shooting workout, perform one high-intensity move into your best available shot. Test which moves execute effectively when fatigued and which finish your arsenal.

drills.name: Feet-Behind Spin
drills.description: Pressured: Send your feet behind you and immediately enter a spin move while maintaining momentum.

drills.name: Standard Layup Series (Overhand, Underhand, Side-Hand)
drills.description: Game-Speed: A fundamental series where you make consecutive makes of overhand, underhand, and side-hand layups.

drills.name: 2v1 / 1v2 Shooting
drills.description: Game-Speed: Read multiple defenders to find space for a short jumper. The 1v2 version is particularly difficult. Adapt to multiple closes.

drills.name: Double Pump Rhythm Drill
drills.description: Pressured: Perform a super-exaggerated pump fake that removes all natural momentum. Immediately refine your rhythm and execute your secondary move or shot. This forces you to work on generating energy from a completely dead stop.

drills.name: Slam and Protect (Rib Tuck)
drills.description: Technique: Finish at the rim and immediately protect the ball by tucking it near your ribs. Simulate a defender attempting to swat or steal. Train contact finishes and ball security.

drills.name: Accel/Decel Flow
drills.description: Pressured: A coordination-heavy drill using one-two, one-two footwork. Sync the ball with your steps.

drills.name: Single Leg RDL Reach to Shot
drills.description: Game-Speed: Perform a single-leg RDL with a reach-out, then transfer energy into a shot. Switch spots every rep. Build dynamic shooting.

drills.name: Lunge Stop Anchor Stop Pull-up
drills.description: Technique: Enter a short lunge during a drive and use an anchor stop (using one foot to kill momentum) to pop into a jumper.

drills.name: Cradle-Change Direction Finish
drills.description: Game-Speed: Incorporate a cradle gather during the mid-air shift to protect the ball from shot-blockers.

drills.name: Pound Between-Behind
drills.description: Form: Pound the ball, go between the legs (dribbling by the big toe), then immediately behind the back while swaying your body with the ball's movement. Work this as a rhythmic drill. Build smooth, coordinated move sequences.

drills.name: Inside Hand Driving Finish
drills.description: Game-Speed: Drive at speed (right or left) and finish with the opposite hand (e.g., drive right, finish left). Get the corresponding leg up for balance and protection (left leg up for left-hand finish). This shields the ball from shot blockers.

drills.name: Ball Pickup Shots
drills.description: Game-Speed: The ball starts on the ground. Reach down, change your level to pick it up, and immediately find your rhythm into a shot. Focus on smooth energy transfer from the ground pickup into shooting.

days.focus: Recovery skills and mental rehearsal of week's drills

drills.name: Corner to Corner Shooting
drills.description: Game-Speed: Alternate corner shots, but the footwork (turn, pivot, or hop) must be different every time. Prevent setup reliance.

drills.name: Split Feet Pound-Between
drills.description: Form: While moving, perform a pound followed by splitting feet as the ball goes between the legs.

drills.name: Wichita Outside Hip Sweep
drills.description: Game-Speed: Practice ripping the ball while keeping it strictly on your outside hip. Jerk to the air, not across your body.

drills.name: Turn and Decide (Close-out)
drills.description: Technique: Turn late to see a defender closing out and decide in a split second whether to shoot or drive.

drills.name: Shoulder-to-Shoulder Recovery
drills.description: Game-Speed: Get bumped off your driving line and use your shoulder to cut off the defender or counter.

drills.name: Hezi In-and-Out Explode
drills.description: Game-Speed: Use a hesitation with an in-and-out dribble while raising your body height to freeze the defender.

drills.name: Change of Speed Push-Out
drills.description: Technique: Raise your body level to slow down, then drop low into a push-out dribble followed by a quick snatch back.

drills.name: Slow Step Extension
drills.description: Pressured: While downhill with a defender on the hip, perform a slow step without stopping. Keep momentum alive.

drills.name: High-Speed Skip Pull-ups
drills.description: Technique: Perform two skips as fast as possible into a high-speed three-point pull-up. Train transition shooting.

drills.name: Inside-Hand Wrap Reverse
drills.description: Game-Speed: Drive toward the baseline and use your inside hand to wrap the ball around the rim in a reverse finishing motion. Use the backboard as a shield and challenge your touch.

drills.name: Wichita Help-Side Counter Pull-up
drills.description: Game-Speed: Visualize a help-side defender rotating over. Execute a counter-move to transition into a pull-up jumper.

drills.name: Separate Back Separation Shot
drills.description: Technique: Get your defender on your hip or behind you. Practice separating back to create a sudden shooting window.

drills.name: Different Footwork Every Rep
drills.description: Pressured: While shooting, you are strictly forbidden from using the same footwork twice. Alternate between turns, pivots, hops, and various lead-foot entries for every make. Prevent overreliance on one setup.

drills.name: Hop Freestyle
drills.description: Game-Speed: Hop on one leg while maintaining a freestyle dribble, progressively increasing the size and speed of your hops. Build ankle stability and improve ball control during explosive, off-balance movements.

drills.name: Arm-Free Pickup Shoot
drills.description: Technique: Drive at game speed with a defender playing tight on your arm. Work to get your arm free specifically during the pickup phase. Get into a fluid shot without allowing the defender to disrupt your rhythm.

drills.name: Stationary Crossovers (Wide Base)
drills.description: Form: Stand in a low, wide stance with hips down, crossing the ball back and forth wider than your knees. The body weight must shift in the direction of the ball with every cross. Build fingertip control and rhythm at game-speed transitions.

drills.name: Weight Shift Pound
drills.description: Form: Perform a hard pound dribble at knee-to-hip level while shifting your body weight from side to side. Keep the ball hitting the same spot while your body moves. Build pressure handling.

drills.name: The Curry Drill
drills.description: Technique: Start at the three-point line and use quick, subtle footwork (step-backs, side steps, in-and-outs) to create space before rising into a jumper. The moves should feel seamless.

drills.name: Over-the-Net Reach
drills.description: Technique: Drive and attempt to make the ball touch the net before pulling it back for a protected finish.

drills.name: Kyrie Cuffing Series
drills.description: Game-Speed: Before entering a finishing move, cuff the ball against your forearm/wrist for total control. Then bring it back to start your move.

drills.name: Object Jump Finish
drills.description: Game-Speed: Place an object on the ground and jump from outside it. Use the resulting hang time for creative hand finishes.

drills.name: Wichita Double Rip
drills.description: Game-Speed: A triple-threat transition drill where you catch on the wing, rip the ball out, then immediately rip back.

drills.name: Bump and Score (5 Variations)
drills.description: Game-Speed: Drive into contact with a defender, then execute five different scoring counters: step-back, floater, reverse, inside-hand finish, and outside-hand finish. Test your composure after initiating contact.

drills.name: Mid-Court Toss-and-Meet
drills.description: Pressured: Toss the ball across the court, meet it at full speed, find your balance, and shoot immediately. Train game-speed mechanics.

drills.name: Cross Step Inverted Between
drills.description: Game-Speed: Cross one foot over the other while going between the legs. Keep your back foot glued to the ground to project your body forward. The move should be explosive and directional. Create instant separation.

drills.name: Single Hand Freestyle
drills.description: Technique: Move at 100% speed across the court, dribbling fluidly using only one hand. Improve weak-hand confidence.
